lines.text: Jesus asks how the scribes can say the Christ is the Son of David when David calls Him Lord.
Jesus warns about scribes who like long robes, marketplace greetings, chief seats in synagogues and places of honor at banquets.
The scribes defraud widows of their houses, make lengthy prayers for a blessing, and will receive greater condemnation.
Jesus watches many rich people put in large amounts, then one poor widow puts in two silver shekels.
Jesus says the poor widow put in more than all the others, giving all she had to live on.
